flow_transcript_slices.question: Tell me about yourself and why early childhood education matters to you.
flow_transcript_slices.candidate_transcript:
[Q1 Attempt 1]
I love working with kids, and I volunteer at a preschool every week in Mahana Beach called American Martyrs, and they're also play-based, and I help them with doing snack cleaning, doing circle time, reading books, and help out in the yard. And it's during the week, like two times a week, and I've been volunteering there for about two years. Yeah, I got it at El Camino.

flow_transcript_slices.question: Why are you applying for this position, specifically at Launch Pad Learning?
flow_transcript_slices.candidate_transcript:
[Q2 Attempt 1]
Because I love the age range of the children. I like working with babies up to four or five, and I like how it's play-based.

flow_transcript_slices.question: Tell me about a time a child was having a really hard moment emotionally. What did you notice about what they were feeling, and how did you respond?
flow_transcript_slices.candidate_transcript:
[Q3 Attempt 1]
One of the kids, one time at American Martyrs, was yelling a lot because he didn't want to go into the circle time. So me and another teacher put him aside and talked out his feelings with him and asked him how he was feeling. And then we gave him an option of joining circle time or doing something else quietly. Yeah, then he joined circle time afterwards. Two others.
